description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveRequestService within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It contains unit tests for methods such as fetching leave statuses, detailed leave requests, and permissible workflows, as well as setting up mock objects and test data.

classes.name: LeaveRequestServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the LeaveRequestService, testing various functionalities related to leave requests, statuses, detailed requests, and workflows.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Tests that the service correctly returns an instance of LeaveRequestDao.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all leave statuses as an associative array.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Tests mapping from status code to status name, including exception handling.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Tests mapping from status name to status code, including exception handling.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByNames
methods.description: Tests mapping from list of status names to list of status codes, with exception handling.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Tests fetching detailed leave request data including associated leaves and ordering.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed workflows for a leave request depending on user role and leave type.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflowsWithDeletedLeaveType
methods.description: Tests workflow retrieval when leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getMockWorkflowActions
methods.description: Helper method to generate mock workflow actions for testing.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Tests conversion of leaves into detailed leave objects.
